title: From Bias Mitigation to Bias Negotiation: Governing Identity and Sociocultural Reasoning in Generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: A controlled text classification probe predicting author gender from real-world physician reviews using different prompting conditions (control vs. emotion/style), accompanied by a thematic analysis of the model's rationales to identify gendered interpretive schemas.

Minimally guided, semi-structured qualitative interviews with multiple publicly deployed chatbots (e.g., GPT-4o, Claude 3, LLaMA 3.1) followed by thematic analysis of the dialogues to evaluate how models conceptualize and reason about sociocultural schemas, identity, intersectionality, and structural power.
